integrity: The moment formula is a known consequence of Poisson cumulants. The claim of new contribution is the sharp optimization and equality geometry. Symbolic and finite checks are supplementary to the explicit analytical proof.
limitations: Equal positive Poisson intensities, real coefficients, first chaos and sixth moments only. The odd-dimensional exact constant uses a finite comparison of cubic algebraic candidates; no universal minimizing multiplicity index is asserted. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp sixth moments and two-level rigidity in finite Poisson first chaos
